claim_at_stake: whether Opus 4.5's T28a predictive signal on TrialBench (mortality, SAE) survives removal of outcome knowledge, holding trial identity knowledge constant -- recall vs genuine reading

inputs.phase_string_format_note: Arm A carries TrialBench's title-case phase strings (Phase2); Arms B/C carry AACT's uppercase ones (PHASE2) plus categories absent from A entirely (PHASE1/PHASE2, EARLY_PHASE1 -- 15.4% of Arm B per the covariates report). Not normalized: doing so changes prompt text, changes the prompt hash, misses the response cache, and re-bills roughly the full run's cost (docs/t28b_reanalysis_plan.md). Deferred pending whether R1/R2 leaves a verdict worth re-running for.
inputs.arm_c_prevalence_note: Arm C's positive rate (mortality 9.6%, SAE 12.5%, both at n=208) is far below Arm A's (39.6%, 67.6%), leaving roughly 20 positive trials per endpoint -- the secondary A-vs-C contrast is uninformative by construction at this n, not a null result, and should be read that way (docs/t28b_reanalysis_plan.md).

disease_swap.note: T22 came back INCONCLUSIVE on disease share, so low sensitivity is not recall on its own -- only interpretable against the reference's sensitivity on the same rows (docs/t28b_opus_recall_spec.md). reference_insensitivity_rate_discretized_to_opus_resolution snaps the reference's continuous score to Opus's own observed value set before recomputing -- if quarantine_ordering only holds against the undiscretized reference, the gap is (at least partly) a resolution mismatch, not differential memorisation (docs/t28b_reanalysis_plan.md R3).
disease_swap.quarantine_ordering_withdrawn_reason: Withdrawn, not deleted -- quarantine_ordering: true was computed from a rendering bug, not evidence of memorisation. elicit_row hardcoded render_arm(row, "L7", ...) for every arm including this swap; swap_disease only replaced row["condition"], and L7's filler concatenates the condition with the trial's own UNSWAPPED brief_summary/textblock, which still named the real disease verbatim. The prompt contradicted itself and the summary won. A second, subtler leak: _render_body's scrubber derives mask terms from the (already-swapped) row["condition"], so it masked the donor's terms while leaving the original disease unredacted in eligibility criteria (which names the trial's condition in 45-61% of trials before scrubbing, per src/data/serialize.py). See docs/t28b_l0_implementation_plan.md for the root-cause analysis and results/experiments/t28b_l0_null.json for the corrected, from-scratch disease-sensitivity probe (arm-parameterised elicit_row/score_arm, a scrub-source/slot-source split via render_arm_with_disease_override, and a pre-call assert_no_disease_leak gate) -- this field is superseded by that artifact's reading, not by a fix to the numbers already collected here.

branch_reason: R1: Opus's auroc drops significantly (delta=0.047, CI=[0.000, 0.093]). R2: that drop does not significantly exceed the reference's own drop on the identical rows (diff=0.009, CI=[-0.039, 0.056], observed correlation rho=0.41809258112501035) -- underpowered to separate Opus's drop from the reference's. Report both drops and the difference with its CI; do not read this as recall demonstrated or as cleared.
disease_swap_note: The disease_swap block above is left in place as the historical record of what was actually collected and analyzed, not deleted -- but quarantine_ordering was withdrawn (see disease_swap.quarantine_ordering_withdrawn_reason) after docs/t28b_l0_implementation_plan.md found the swap arm was rendered via a hardcoded L7, so the "swapped" prompt still named the real disease. Do not cite quarantine_ordering from this file as evidence for or against memorisation; see results/experiments/t28b_l0_null.json.
